en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a canal or river in the foreground, stone embankment, and several trees framing a central obelisk monument. Behind the monument stands an ornate historic town hall building with a tall spire and clock, flanked by other classical town houses. Parked vintage cars from the early 20th century line the street on the right. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the lower left and lower right edges.
